cpu-diagnostic-v1.sample_method: owned per-thread perf_event_open PERF_TYPE_SOFTWARE CPU_CLOCK,10msperiod, userspace IP+callchains; CLOCK_MONOTONIC; kernel/hypervisor excluded
limits: Software CPU-clock IP sample counts are statistical, not cycle-exact.
Short-lived threads may be missed before100msdiscovery.
Callchains may truncate without frame pointers; raw IPs/maps retained.
Visible marker samples record presented revisions, not every internal model event.
These instrumented observations are excluded from performance medians.

latest_preceding_maps_resolution_v1.resolution: latest preceding /proc maps snapshot, executable mappings only

owned_code_analysis_v3.resolution: latest preceding /proc maps snapshot; executable mappings only
owned_code_analysis_v3.scope: only owned-child anonymous RX bytes; each window begins at a sampled instruction IP
limits: Byte snapshots represent their recorded capture times, not proof that every sample saw identical code.
Raw machine instructions have no established function or shader-stage names.
Samples are software CPU-clock statistical observations and may skid, not cycle-exact instruction cost or whole-program attribution.
